blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding gender biases in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important as these systems become embedded in decision-support tools with real consequences. Prior research has focused only on a small set of models, leaving open the extent to which gender biases are common and heterogeneous across LLMs. We address this gap across ten models released between April 2025 and June 2026, spanning nine vendors, using two paradigms: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases (Study 1) and moral judgment of abuse or torture against a woman or a man to prevent a catastrophic outcome (Study 2). In Study 1, two of ten models attributed masculine-stereotyped phrases to female writers more often than the reverse, while three models showed the opposite pattern. In Study 2, several models converged on a male-disadvantaging asymmetry that was directionally consistent with a documented human tendency to protect female targets from harm, though the specific conditions under which this asymmetry emerged varied by model; three other models, by contrast, showed no variation across conditions. These results indicate that gender-related biases are common in LLMs. Their direction and magnitude, however, are highly heterogeneous, to the point that some models behave in diametrically opposite ways to others. Bias auditing should therefore be treated as an ongoing, multi-vendor process, rather than a one-time assessment.
blocks.zh: 了解大语言模型中的性别偏见越来越重要,因为这些系统已嵌入决策支助工具,并产生实际后果。 先前的研究只侧重于一套小的模型,使不同专业学校的性别偏见变得普遍和多样。 我们在2025年4月至2026年6月期间发布了10种模式,涉及9个销售商,我们通过两种模式解决这一差距:性别归属于定型短语(研究1)和对虐待或酷刑妇女或男子的道德判断,以防止灾难性后果(研究2)。 在研究1中,十个模型中有两个将男性定型的短语归结到女性作家身上比相反的更常见,而三个模型则显示出相反的模式. 在研究2中,一些模型集中反映了一种不利于男性的不对称现象,这种不对称现象与人类保护女性目标免受伤害的有据可查的趋势是一致的,尽管这种不对称现象出现的具体条件因模型而异;相比之下,其他三种模型则显示,不同条件之间没有差异。 这些结果表明,与性别有关的偏见在法学硕士课程中很常见。 然而,它们的方向和规模差异很大,以至于有些模型的行为方式与另一些模型截然相反。 因此,应当将偏见审计视为一个持续、多供应商的过程,而不是一次性评估。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Since their widespread public release, large language models (LLMs) have been rapidly integrated into applications spanning content generation, decision support, virtual assistants, and automated moderation. Alongside these capabilities, a substantial body of work has documented that LLMs can learn, perpetuate, and even amplify harmful social biases present in their training data ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ; Capraro et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) . Because these models are now deployed at a scale that touches the everyday decisions of a large and diverse user base, biases that might once have been dismissed as a narrow technical curiosity can translate into real, systemic disadvantage ( Sachan et al., 2025 ; Mökander et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 自其广泛公开发布以来,大型语言模型(LLMS)被迅速集成到涵盖内容生成,决策支持,虚拟助手,以及自动化节制的应用程序中. 除了这些能力之外,大量工作还表明,法学硕士可以学习、延续甚至扩大培训数据中存在的有害社会偏见(Gallegos等人,2024年;Capraro等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年)。 由于这些模型现在的部署规模涉及到一个庞大和多样化的用户基础的日常决定,可能曾经因为狭隘的技术好奇心而被否定的偏见会转化为真正的、系统性的劣势(Sachan等人,2025年;Mökander等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Gender bias has been among the most extensively documented forms of bias in LLMs ( Pikuliak, 2025 ) . Fulgu and Capraro (2024) found that three OpenAI GPT models (GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4, and GPT-4o) attributed a stereotypically masculine phrase to a female writer far more often than a stereotypically feminine phrase was attributed to a male writer, an asymmetry the authors attributed to fine-tuning techniques such as reinforcement learning from human feedback rather than to the training corpus itself. The same models, when asked to judge the acceptability of using violence to prevent a catastrophic outcome, treated violence against a man as more acceptable than equivalent violence against a woman—a pattern that extended to abuse, a form of violence central to the gender-parity debate, but not to torture, a form of violence less central to it ( Penttinen, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 性别偏见是LLMs(Pikuliak,2025年)中记录最广泛的偏见形式之一。 Fulgu和Capraro (2024年)发现,三个OpenAI GPT模型(GPT-3.5 Turbo,GPT-4和GPT-4o)将一个定型男性的短语归咎于女作家,远多于将一个定型女性的短语归咎于男作家,作者将这种不对称归因于从人类反馈中强化学习等微调技术,而不是培训大纲本身。 同样的模式,在被要求判断使用暴力防止灾难性后果的可接受性时,将针对男性的暴力视为比针对女性的同等暴力更可接受——这种模式延伸至虐待,这种暴力形式是两性均等辩论的核心,而不是酷刑,这种暴力形式不那么重要(Pentinen, 2024)。

blocks.en: Related asymmetries have since been reported well beyond this GPT-only sample. Bajaj et al. (2024) introduced a dataset of parallel short stories with male and female protagonists and found that GPT, Llama, Mistral, and Claude models consistently provided more favorable moral judgments of female characters, though the magnitude of this asymmetry ranged from 68–85% of cases depending on the model. Chen et al. (2025) similarly found a consistent overrepresentation of female characters across occupations in ten LLMs, though attributed this pattern primarily to alignment procedures rather than to stereotype attribution specifically. Pikuliak (2025) , evaluating a broader battery of gender-bias probes across 12 LLMs from six vendors, likewise reported a consistent tendency for models to favor women over men.
blocks.zh: 从那时以来,相关不对称性的报告远远超出了这个仅限全球采样的样本。 Bajaj等人(2024年)推出了一个与男女主角平行的短篇故事数据集,并发现GPT,Llama,Mistral,和Claude模型一致地为女性角色提供了更有利的道德判断,尽管这种不对称的程度从68–85%的个案不等,取决于模型的不同. 陈等. (2025年)同样发现,在10个法学硕士课程中,各职业中女性角色的比例一直偏高,尽管这种格局主要归因于调整程序,而不是具体地归因于定型观念的归属。 Pikuliak(2025年)对来自6家销售商的12家有限责任公司进行了更广泛的性别偏见调查,并报告说,模型中一直存在偏向女性而不是男性的趋势。

blocks.en: Taken together, these prior studies provide suggestive evidence of a female-favoring asymmetry across models and tasks. However, because they employ substantially different paradigms, their findings cannot establish how widespread this bias is or whether it varies across models. Determining the prevalence and heterogeneity of gender bias requires comparing a broad range of models within a common experimental framework. This study addresses this question directly by examining gender bias across ten LLMs released between April 2025 and June 2026 from nine vendors, using two task paradigms previously applied to a smaller set of models: gender attribution to stereotyped phrases and moral judgment in sacrificial dilemmas.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些前期研究为模型和任务中有利于女性的不对称提供了有力的证据。 然而,由于它们采用的模式大不相同,它们的结论无法确定这种偏见的广度,也无法确定这种偏见是否因模式而异。 要确定性别偏见的普遍性和异性,就需要在共同的试验框架内对广泛的模型进行比较。 这项研究直接研究了9个供应商在2025年4月至2026年6月期间发布的10个法学硕士课程中的性别偏见问题,使用了以前适用于一套较小模式的两个任务模式:性别归属于定型短语和在牺牲困境中的道德判断。

blocks.en: We find that gender bias in these ten models is common and heterogeneous. Most models show some form of gender-related asymmetry in at least one of the two tasks, but the specific pattern—which gender is favored, how strongly, and whether it appears at all—varies markedly across models, and the broad convergence suggested by prior work does not hold consistently across this set of models. These inconsistencies carry real stakes: as LLMs become further embedded in everyday decision-making, understanding whether their gender biases are a shared, predictable property or an unpredictable patchwork across models and vendors is essential for knowing how, and how urgently, to monitor and address them.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,这十种模式中的性别偏见是常见的和多种多样的。 多数模式在至少两项任务之一中显示出某种形式的与性别有关的不对称,但具体模式——性别偏好、强度和是否出现——在模式中明显不同,以往工作建议的广泛趋同并不一致。 这些不一致之处涉及真正的利害关系:随着法学硕士课程进一步扎根于日常决策,了解其性别偏见是共同的、可预测的财产,还是模型和供应商之间无法预测的杂乱无章,对于了解如何和如何紧迫地监测和解决这些偏见至关重要。

blocks.en: 2 Study 1: Gendered phrases
blocks.zh: 2 研究 1. 性别短语

blocks.en: 2.1 Methods
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 方法

blocks.en: 2.1.1 A note on sex and gender terminology
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 国家 关于性和性别术语的说明

blocks.en: Following the Sex and Gender Equity in Research (SAGER) guidelines ( Heidari et al., 2016 ) , we explicitly define our use of sex and gender terminology throughout this paper. In our analysis, “gender” refers to the socially constructed category that each model attributes to a hypothetical writer, inferred from stereotypical linguistic and behavioral cues rather than from any biological indicator. We do not measure or make claims about sex as a biological category. Models’ responses in Study 1 were coded as girl, boy, or non-binary based on the model’s own stated attribution; no participant or model was asked about sex assigned at birth, as no human research subjects were involved in this study. Because the Study 1 stimuli were designed to resemble writing by elementary-school-aged children, and the prompt itself requests an age alongside a gender (see Section 2.1.4 ), we use “girl”/“boy” terminology in this study, rather than “woman”/“man”, to match the age category being attributed. We avoid “female”/“male” terminology throughout, as these terms more commonly denote sex rather than the socially attributed gender category under study here.
blocks.zh: 根据《研究中的性别和性别平等(SAGER)准则》(Heidari等人,2016年),我们在整个本文中明确定义了我们使用性和性别术语的情况。 在我们的分析中,“性别”是指每个模型将社会构造的类别归结为假设的作家,从定型语言和行为提示而不是从任何生物指标推断出来。 我们不把性作为一个生物类别来衡量或提出权利主张。 模型在研究1中的答复是根据模型自己说明的归属来编码为女孩、男孩或非二进制的;没有向参与者或模型询问出生时的性别分配,因为这项研究没有涉及人类研究课题。 由于第1项研究的刺激性设计类似于小学适龄儿童的写作,而即期本身则要求将年龄与性别并列(见第2.1.4节),因此我们在本研究中使用了“女孩”/“男孩”的术语,而不是“妇女”/“男人”的术语,以与所归属的年龄类别相匹配。 我们始终避免使用“女性”/“男性”的术语,因为这些术语更通常地指性别,而不是本文所研究的社会性别类别。

blocks.en: 2.1.3 Stimuli

We reused 20 pairs of gender-stereotyped phrases from Fulgu and Capraro (2024) without modification. Seventeen pairs were experimental phrases: each pair contrasted one phrase associated with a stereotypically feminine characteristic against one associated with a stereotypically masculine characteristic, spanning hobbies, toys, colors, films, sports, and personality traits (e.g., dolls versus action figures, pink versus blue, caring versus tough), without explicit mention of the writer’s gender. For example, the feminine-stereotyped phrase “My favorit toy is my doll Molly!” was paired with the masculine-stereotyped phrase “My favorit toy is my Superman action figure!” The phrases intentionally contained spelling mistakes and informal language to resemble the writing style of elementary-school-aged children. The remaining three pairs were control phrases, in which the writer’s gender was explicitly stated (e.g., “I am a clever girl” versus “I am a clever boy”), included to verify each model’s baseline accuracy at gender identification when it is not required to rely on stereotypical inference. The full list of phrases is reported in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 我们重新使用了来自富尔古和卡普拉罗(2024年)的20对性别定型短语,未作修改. 17对是实验性的短语:每对短语将一个与陈规定型女性特征有关的短语与一个与陈规定型男性特征有关的短语作对比,这些短语涉及爱好、玩具、颜色、电影、体育和个性特征(例如,玩偶与动作人物、粉红色与蓝色、关爱与强硬),但没有明确提及作家的性别。 例如,女性定型短语“我的宠爱玩具是我的娃娃Molly!”与男性定型短语“我的宠爱玩具是我的超人动作人物!”对齐。 这些短语有意包含拼写错误和非正式语言,以类似于小学学龄儿童的写作风格。 其余三对是控制语,其中明确表述了作家的性别(例如, " 我是一个聪明的女孩 " 和 " 我是一个聪明的男孩 " ),包括当不需要依赖陈规定型推论时,核实每个模型在性别识别方面的基线准确性。 全文见补充材料。

blocks.en: 2.1.4 Procedure
Each model was prompted, for each of the 40 phrases, with:
blocks.zh: 40个短语中的每一句都促使每个模型:

blocks.en: Could you imagine a potential writer for this phrase? ‘ [phrase] ’. I need a name, an age and a gender.
blocks.zh: 你能想象一个潜在的作家吗? 曰:[口. 我需要一个名字,一个年龄和一个性别。

blocks.en: This prompt was applied identically across all ten models, ensuring that any differences observed reflect differences in the models’ responses rather than in the instructions provided. Each prompt was presented ten times per phrase, using each model’s incognito or temporary-chat feature for every iteration, so that no session retained memory of prior responses and models could not be influenced by their own earlier answers within the same phrase.
blocks.zh: 在所有10种模式中都同样适用了这一提示,确保所观察到的任何差异都反映模式答复中的差异,而不是所提供的指示中的差异。 每个提示每句给出10次,使用每个模型的无记号或临时聊天功能,用于每个迭代,这样,任何会话都无法保留对先前反应和模型的记忆,也不能受到同一短语中自己先前答案的影响.

blocks.en: 2.1.5 Coding of responses
blocks.zh: 2.1.5 答复的编码

blocks.en: Responses were coded as 1 = 1= girl, 0 = 0= boy, and 0.5 = 0.5= non-binary. In a small number of cases, a single response included two or more co-equal gender attributions (e.g., boy and non-binary); each attribution was retained as a separate data point, so some phrases’ averages are computed from more than 10 responses. In other cases, a response described a transgender writer; such responses were coded according to the writer’s stated gender identity (e.g., a transgender female-to-male (FTM) was coded as boy, 0 0 ).
blocks.zh: 答复编码为1=1=女孩,0=0=男孩,0.5=0.5=非二进制. 在少数情况下,一个单一的答复包括两个或两个以上平等性别归属(例如男孩和非二进制);每个归属被保留作为一个单独的数据点,因此一些短语的平均值是从10多个答复中计算出来的。 在其他情况下,一份答复描述了一名变性作家;这种答复是根据该作家所述的性别身份编码的(例如,一名变性女性对男性(FTM)被编码为男孩,0 0)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Methods
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 方法

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Design

Study 2 uses a 2 (action: abuse vs. torture) × \times 2 (victim: woman vs. man) design, embedded in a nuclear-apocalypse framing, that crosses victim gender with a dimension of violence carrying different degrees of gender-political salience: abuse is closely tied to real-world discourse on gender-based violence, whereas torture carries no comparable gendered connotation ( Hearn and McKie, 2010 ; Penttinen, 2024 ) . This framework makes it possible to distinguish between a general tendency to protect against suffering based on gender—which would manifest equally for both types of action—and an asymmetry specifically linked to the sociopolitical significance of a particular form of violence, which, on the other hand, would manifest more markedly—or exclusively—in cases of abuse. This same 2 × 2 2\times 2 structure was previously used in Study 2b of Fulgu and Capraro (2024) .
blocks.zh: 研究2使用一种2(行动:虐待与酷刑) ×\time 2(受害者:妇女与男子)设计,嵌入在核丑闻框架之中,将受害者性别与具有不同程度性别政治特征的暴力方面交叉:虐待与现实世界关于基于性别的暴力的论述密切相关,而酷刑没有类似的性别内涵(Hern和McKie,2010年;Penttinen,2024年)。 这一框架可以区分两种情况:一种是保护免受基于性别的痛苦的普遍趋势,这两类行动都同样表现出来;另一种是特别与某种形式暴力的社会政治意义有关的不对称,另一方面,这种暴力在虐待案件中表现得更为明显,或者完全如此。 这个相同的2×2 2\times 2结构曾用于Fulgu和Capraro(2024年)的研究2b中.

blocks.en: We use “woman”/“man” terminology throughout this study, rather than “girl”/“boy” as in Study 1 (Section 2.1 ), since the scenario involves adult moral agents rather than child writers.
blocks.zh: 我们在整个研究中使用“妇女”/“男人”的术语,而不是第1研究(第2.1节)中使用“女孩”/“男孩”的术语,因为情景涉及的是成人道德代理人而不是儿童作家。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Models tested
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 测试模型

blocks.en: The same ten models described in Study 1 were tested here (Table 1 , labels 2a–2j), accessed under the same conditions (default model settings, standard web/app interface, except for Mistral Small 4, which was accessed via API). All models were tested between 22–29 May 2026, with the exception of Claude Fable 5, tested on 12 June 2026 and 1 July 2026 (see Section 3.1.5 below).

Each model was asked the following question, with the bracketed condition substituted across the four conditions (abuse a woman, abuse a man, torture a woman, torture a man):

blocks.en: 3.1.4 Missing data and refusals
blocks.zh: 3.1.4 国家 数据缺失和拒绝

blocks.en: Some models occasionally declined to answer. Refused iterations were left as empty cells, since standard listwise-deletion procedures handle missing values appropriately without further adjustment. Consequently, the effective n n per condition was below 50 for two models: Gemini 3.1 Pro ( n = 45 n=45 for abuse-woman, n = 47 n=47 for torture-woman) and Claude Fable 5 ( n = 34 n=34 for abuse-woman). All other model-by-condition cells had a full sample size n = 50 n=50 .
blocks.zh: 有些模型偶尔会拒绝回答. 拒绝的重迭被留作空格,因为标准列表删除程序在不作进一步调整的情况下适当处理缺失值。 因此,每个条件的有效n低于50:双子座3.1 Pro(n=45 n=45 虐待-女性,n=47 n=47 酷刑-女性)和克劳德·寓言5(n=34 n=34 虐待-女性)。 所有其他型号逐条件细胞的样本大小为n=50n=50.

blocks.en: 3.1.5 Claude Fable 5: export-control interruption
blocks.zh: 3.1.5 (中文(简体) ). Claude Fable 5: 出口管制中断

blocks.en: On 12 June 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce suspended access to Claude Fable 5 worldwide as part of new export controls; the controls were lifted on 30 June 2026, and Anthropic restored global access on 1 July 2026 ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026a ) . This interrupted our data collection midway through the torture conditions: at the point of suspension, only 25 of 50 iterations had been completed for both torture-woman and torture-man, while the abuse conditions had already been fully collected (50/50 for abuse-man; 34/50 for abuse-woman, capped by refusals unrelated to the suspension). We cannot rule out that some aspect of the model changed between the two data-collection windows, since redeployments of this kind are not always fully documented; we therefore compared the 25 pre-suspension and 25 post-restoration iterations directly for each torture condition. For torture-woman, all 50 responses were identical both before and after the suspension ( M = 5.00 M=5.00 , S ​ D = 0 SD=0 ). For torture-man, the two halves did not differ significantly ( t ⁡ ( 48 ) = 0.46 t(48)=0.46 , p = .645 p=.645 ). We therefore resumed and completed the remaining 25 iterations for both torture conditions on 1 July 2026, bringing Claude Fable 5 to a full n = 50 n=50 across all four conditions except abuse-woman ( n = 34 n=34 ).
blocks.zh: 2026年6月12日,美国商务部作为新出口管制的一部分,暂停了对Claude Fable 5的全球访问;2026年6月30日解除了控制,安特罗皮克于2026年7月1日恢复了全球访问(Anthropic,2026b;Anthropic,2026a). 这中断了我们在酷刑条件下的数据收集工作:在暂停期间,在50次重复中,只有25次是针对酷刑妇女和酷刑男子的,而虐待条件已经完全收集(第50/50次针对虐待男子;第34/50次针对虐待妇女,以与中止无关的拒绝为上限)。 我们不能排除模式的某些方面在两个数据收集窗口之间发生了变化,因为这种重新部署并非总是有充分的文件记录;因此,我们比较了每个酷刑状况的25次暂停前和25次恢复后重复。 对于酷刑妇女,所有50份答复在停职前后都是相同的(M = 5.00 M = 5.0,S D = 0 SD = 0)。 对于酷刑男子来说,两个半身没有显著区别(t ⁡(48)=0.46 t(48)=0.46,p=645 p=645),因此,我们于2026年7月1日恢复并完成了对两个酷刑条件的其余25次重复,使克洛德·福尔5在除虐待-妇女(n = 34n=34)以外的所有4个条件中均达到完全n=50n=50。

blocks.en: 3.1.6 Statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 3.1.6 统计分析

blocks.en: For each model, we conducted four pairwise comparisons (woman vs. man within torture; woman vs. man within abuse; torture vs. abuse for woman victims; torture vs. abuse for man victims), each via an independent-samples t t -test and a companion Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney rank-sum test. As in Study 1, several models returned the identical response across all iterations of one or more conditions, yielding zero variance and a mathematically undefined test statistic rather than a non-significant result; in these cases we report the comparison descriptively (mean, S ​ D = 0 SD=0 , n n ) rather than force a statistic.
blocks.zh: 在每个模式中,我们进行了4次对等比较(酷刑中女性与男性;虐待中女性与男性;虐待女性受害者;酷刑与虐待男性受害者),每个模式都通过一个独立样本 t - t - 测试和一个同伴Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney的等级总和测试。 与研究1一样,若干模型在一个或多个条件的所有迭代中返回了相同的反应,得出零差异和数学上未定义的测试统计,而不是非重大结果;在这些情况中,我们报告的是描述性比较(平均值,S D = 0 SD = 0,n n ),而不是强迫统计。

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the mean agreement (1–7 scale) for each of the four conditions, by model; Figure 2 presents the same means as a heatmap across all ten models. For each model, we report all four pairwise comparisons specified in Methods: gender, within torture and within abuse; and violence type, within woman-victim and within man-victim conditions.
blocks.zh: 表3按模型列出四个条件中每个条件的平均协议(1至7个比例尺);图2列出所有十个模型的热图。 对于每一种模式,我们报告方法中规定的所有四种对等比较:性别、酷刑和虐待;暴力类型、女性受害者和男性受害者状况。

blocks.en: Three models showed extreme, and diametrically opposed, response patterns. Llama 4 Scout (Study 2a) and Microsoft Copilot (Study 2g) rated every single iteration across all four conditions as completely unacceptable ( M = 1.00 M=1.00 , “strongly disagree”), while DeepSeek V4-Flash (Study 2h) rated every iteration across all four conditions as completely acceptable ( M = 7.00 M=7.00 , “strongly agree”), regardless of victim gender or type of violence. This left no variance within any of these three models, so none of the four comparisons yielded a defined test statistic.
blocks.zh: 三种模型表现出极端和截然相反的反应模式。 Llama 4 Scout (Study 2a)和微软副驾驶(Study 2g)将所有四个条件的每个迭代评为完全不能接受(M=1.00 M=1.00,"强烈不同意"),而DeepSeek V4-Flash (Study 2h)将所有四个条件的每一个迭代评为完全可以接受的(M=7.00 M=7.00,"强烈同意"),无论受害人性别或暴力类型如何. 这在这三个模型中都没有任何差异,因此四个比较中都没有得出一个确定的测试统计数据。

blocks.en: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Study 2c) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (Study 2d) both revealed significant gender gaps, but with surprisingly different patterns. Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Study 2c) gave uniform “strongly agree” responses ( M = 7.00 M=7.00 ) for both torture conditions and for abuse-man, but rated abuse-woman far lower ( M = 1.48 M=1.48 ; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 35.13 t(98)=-35.13 , p < .001 p<.001 )—an almost binary pattern, with a single condition dropping from the maximum to nearly the minimum on the scale, while the other three remained fixed at the maximum. Correspondingly, within woman-victim conditions, torture was rated significantly more acceptable than abuse ( M = 7.00 M=7.00 vs. M = 1.48 M=1.48 ; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = 35.13 t(98)=35.13 , p < .001 p<.001 ), whereas within man-victim conditions the two ratings did not differ (both M = 7.00 M=7.00 ; identical, no test defined). Gemini 3.1 Pro showed a more graded pattern across all four conditions: uniform “strongly agree” responses for both man-victim conditions ( M = 7.00 M=7.00 ; no test defined), but significant gender gaps for both torture ( M = 6.74 M=6.74 for women vs. 7.00 7.00 for men; t ⁡ ( 95 ) = − 2.13 t(95)=-2.13 , p = .035 p=.035 ) and abuse ( M = 4.87 M=4.87 for women vs. 7.00 7.00 for men; t ⁡ ( 93 ) = − 5.20 t(93)=-5.20 , p < .001 p<.001 ); within woman-victim conditions, torture was in turn rated significantly more acceptable than abuse ( t ⁡ ( 90 ) = 4.25 t(90)=4.25 , p < .001 p<.001 ).
blocks.zh: Claude Sonnet 4.6(研究2c)和双子座3.1 Pro(研究2d)都揭示了显著的性别差距,但模式却惊人地不同。 Claude Sonnet 4.6(研究2(c))对酷刑条件和虐待男子都给出了统一的“强烈同意”的答复(M=7.00M=7.00),但被评为虐待妇女的程度要低得多(M=1.48M=1.48;t(98)=-35.13t(98)=-35.13,p <.001p < 001)——几乎是二进制模式,一个单一条件从最高水平降到了几乎最低水平,而其他三个条件仍然是最高水平。 相应地,在受害妇女条件下,对酷刑的评分比对虐待的评分高得多(M=7.00M=7.00对M=1.48M=1.48;t=35.13t(98)=35.13,p < 001p < 001),而在受害男子条件下,两种评分没有差别(M=7.00M=7.00;相同,没有确定测试标准)。 双子座3.1 Pro在所有四个条件中都显示出更严格的等级模式:对两个男性受害者条件作出一致的“强烈同意”反应(M=7.00 M=7.00;没有界定测试),但两种酷刑的性别差距都很大(M=6.74 M=6.74 M=6.001,男子为7.001);在妇女受害者条件中,酷刑的评级明显高于虐待(t=2.13 t(95)=2.13,p=2.13,p=0.35 p=035)和虐待(M=4.87 M=4.87,妇女为7.00,男子为7.001;t=5.20 t(93)=5.20 t(93)=-5.20,p < 001 p < 001);在妇女受害者条件中,酷刑的评级则明显高于虐待(t=(90)=4.25 t=4.25,p < 001 p < 001)。

blocks.en: The remaining five models showed non-degenerate variance across most or all conditions, with mixed patterns and widely varying means. Grok 4.1 Fast (Study 2b) showed a significant gender gap for abuse ( M = 5.32 M=5.32 for women vs. 7.00 7.00 for men; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 4.54 t(98)=-4.54 , p < .001 p<.001 ) but not for torture ( M = 6.94 M=6.94 vs. 6.98 6.98 ; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 1.02 t(98)=-1.02 , p = .312 p=.312 ); within woman-victim conditions, torture was rated significantly more acceptable than abuse ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = 4.36 t(98)=4.36 , p < .001 p<.001 ), while within man-victim conditions the two ratings did not differ ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 1.00 t(98)=-1.00 , p = .320 p=.320 ). Mistral Small 4 (Study 2e) showed the opposite gender pattern: a significant gap for torture ( M = 4.84 M=4.84 for women vs. 6.20 6.20 for men; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 4.49 t(98)=-4.49 , p < .001 p<.001 ) but not for abuse ( M = 4.12 M=4.12 vs. 4.78 4.78 ; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 1.55 t(98)=-1.55 , p = .125 p=.125 ); within man-victim conditions, torture was rated significantly more acceptable than abuse ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = 4.89 t(98)=4.89 , p < .001 p<.001 ), with no such difference for women ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = 1.65 t(98)=1.65 , p = .101 p=.101 ). GPT-5.5 (Study 2f) showed significant gender gaps for both torture ( M = 1.22 M=1.22 for women vs. 5.44 5.44 for men; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 19.16 t(98)=-19.16 , p < .001 p<.001 ) and abuse ( M = 1.04 M=1.04 vs. 6.10 6.10 ; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 24.99 t(98)=-24.99 , p < .001 p<.001 ); notably, the direction of the torture-versus-abuse comparison itself reversed by victim gender, with torture rated as more acceptable than abuse within woman-victim conditions ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = 2.75 t(98)=2.75 , p = .007 p=.007 ) and abuse rated as more acceptable than torture within man-victim conditions ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 2.26 t(98)=-2.26 , p = .026 p=.026 ). Qwen3.6 (Study 2i) showed a significant gender gap for torture ( M = 5.08 M=5.08 for women vs. 6.88 6.88 for men; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 4.31 t(98)=-4.31 , p < .001 p<.001 ); for abuse, abuse-woman ( M = 1.00 M=1.00 ) and abuse-man ( M = 7.00 M=7.00 ) both had zero variance at opposite ends of the scale, so t t is not mathematically defined, though the rank-sum test confirms the difference ( z = − 9.95 z=-9.95 , p < .001 p<.001 ). Within woman-victim conditions, torture was rated far more acceptable than abuse ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = 10.20 t(98)=10.20 , p < .001 p<.001 ), while within man-victim conditions the two ratings did not differ ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 1.00 t(98)=-1.00 , p = .320 p=.320 ). Claude Fable 5 (Study 2j) showed significant, though comparatively modest, gender gaps for both torture ( M = 5.00 M=5.00 for women vs. 5.10 5.10 for men; t ⁡ ( 98 ) = − 2.33 t(98)=-2.33 , p = .022 p=.022 ) and abuse ( M = 4.79 M=4.79 vs. 5.06 5.06 ; t ⁡ ( 82 ) = − 3.74 t(82)=-3.74 , p < .001 p<.001 ), with means clustered near the midpoint of the scale (4.8–5.1) rather than at either extreme; within woman-victim conditions, torture was rated significantly more acceptable than abuse ( t ⁡ ( 82 ) = 3.56 t(82)=3.56 , p < .001 p<.001 ), with no such difference within man-victim conditions ( t ⁡ ( 98 ) = 0.73 t(98)=0.73 , p = .466 p=.466 ).

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The central finding of this investigation is that gender bias in large language models is common and highly heterogeneous: eight of the ten models tested showed a significant gender-related asymmetry in at least one of the two studies—gender bias in current LLMs is not the exception, but the norm.
blocks.zh: 这项调查的核心结论是,大语言模式中的性别偏见是常见的,而且差异很大:在所测试的十种模式中,有八种模式至少在两项研究中显示出与性别有关的严重不对称——现行法学硕士课程中的性别偏见并非例外,而是规范。

blocks.en: In Study 1, two models (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Mistral Small 4) showed a significant asymmetry in the direction I M > I F I_{M}>I_{F} , three (Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4-Flash, Qwen3.6) showed the opposite, and the remaining five showed no significant effect. This heterogeneity aligns with recent work that has questioned the stability of gender-bias measurements in LLMs: Kumar et al. (2026) found that minimal, task-irrelevant changes to a prompt’s context can make correlations between LLM outputs and gender stereotypes weaken or disappear entirely, in a task methodologically close to our own. Gender-attribution bias appears highly sensitive to superficial context, which may make the disagreement we observe across ten models—differing in training data, fine-tuning procedures, and vendor—unsurprising. Mirza et al. (2025) reached a similar conclusion when studying occupational stereotypes: the underlying tendency toward gender-stereotyped attribution appears broad, but its manifestation is highly method- and model-dependent.
blocks.zh: 在研究1中,两种模型(Claude Sonnet 4.6,Mistral Small 4)显示方向I M > I F I_{M}>I_{F},三种模型(Gemini 3.1 Pro,DeepSeek V4-Flash,Qune3.6)显示相反,其余五种模型显示没有显著效果. 这种异质性与最近的工作一致, Kumar等人(2026年)发现,在方法上接近我们自己的任务中,与任务无关的微小变化可以使LLM产出和性别陈规定型观念之间的关联完全削弱或消失。 性别分配偏见似乎对表面环境高度敏感,这可能使我们在10种模式中发现的分歧——在培训数据、微调程序和销售商方面的差异——不足为奇。 Mirza等人(2025年)在研究职业定型观念时得出了类似的结论:性别定型归属的基本趋势似乎广泛,但其表现高度依赖方法和模式。

blocks.en: Study 2’s results connect more directly to an emerging pattern in the literature that several recent studies describe as a male-disadvantaging, or “moral chivalry,” asymmetry in LLM moral judgment. Si et al. (2026) evaluated ten current-generation LLMs on gender-mirrored conflict scenarios and found a consistent pattern in which male actors received more punitive framing than female actors for equivalent conduct—the same direction we observe in the six models that judged abuse of a man as more acceptable than abuse of a woman (Grok 4.1 Fast, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5, Qwen3.6, Claude Fable 5). Jin et al. (2025) similarly found, across 19 LLMs evaluated on trolley-style dilemmas, that models most misaligned with human moral preferences showed an exaggerated tendency to protect female characters specifically, with gender showing the strongest correlation with human-model misalignment among the dimensions tested. Lam and Mesch (2026) extended a closely related paradigm to sentencing recommendations and found that several current models recommended more indulgent treatment for female perpetrators of intimate partner violence specifically, but not for other offense types—a pattern that echoes our own finding that the gender gap in Study 2 was substantially larger for abuse (a mean gap of 2.13 2.13 points across the ten models) than for torture (a mean gap of 0.78 0.78 points).
blocks.zh: 研究2的结果更直接地与最近一些研究描述的文学中一种新出现的模式联系在一起,即“道德骑士”在LLM道德判断中的不对称。 Si等人(2026年)评价了10个关于性别迷恋冲突情景的当代LLMs,并发现了一种一贯的模式,即男性行为者在同等行为方面比女性行为者得到更惩罚性的陷害——我们在6种模式中观察到的相同方向,这些模式认为虐待男性比虐待女性更容易被接受(Grok 4.1 Fast, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5, Qune3.6, Claude Fable5)。 龚等. (2025年)同样发现,在对推力式困境评价的19个LLMs中,与人类道德偏好最不吻合的模型显示出特别保护女性人物的夸大倾向,性别在测试维度时显示出与人类模型错位关系最强的. Lam和Mesch(2026年)将一个密切相关的模式扩展至判决建议,并发现一些现行模式建议对亲密伴侣暴力的女施虐者给予更宽容的待遇,但对其他犯罪类型则不这样做——这一模式与我们自己的结论一致,即研究2中的性别差距因虐待(十个模式的平均差距为2.132.13分)远远大于酷刑(平均差距为0.780.78分)。

blocks.en: Beyond this broader pattern, the ten models differed sharply in their baseline moral judgments, independently of gender bias. Llama 4 Scout and Microsoft Copilot rated every condition in Study 2 as completely unacceptable ( M = 1.00 M=1.00 ), whereas DeepSeek V4-Flash rated every condition as completely acceptable ( M = 7.00 M=7.00 ). Thus, although none of these three models showed measurable gender bias, they reached opposite conclusions about the underlying dilemma. Mistral Small 4 and Claude Fable 5, meanwhile, both gave average ratings close to the midpoint, but for very different reasons. Mistral Small 4’s responses were spread widely across nearly the entire scale in three of the four conditions, with no consistent position from one iteration to the next: genuine instability, not a settled judgment. Claude Fable 5’s responses, by contrast, were tightly clustered at or near the midpoint across nearly every iteration: consistent uncertainty, rather than instability. The models that did show a gender gap also differed considerably in how that gap emerged. GPT-5.5 showed a similarly large gap for both abuse ( 5.06 5.06 points) and torture ( 4.22 4.22 points). Qwen3.6, however, showed a much larger gap for abuse ( 6.00 6.00 points) than for torture ( 1.80 1.80 points). In other words, the asymmetry extended across both forms of violence in one model but was concentrated mainly in abuse in the other. Claude Sonnet 4.6 showed one of the most extreme patterns: its ratings were at or near the top of the scale ( M = 7.00 M=7.00 ) in three conditions but fell close to the bottom ( M = 1.48 M=1.48 ) when the victim was a woman experiencing abuse. These differences in response patterns are documented in full for every model in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 除了这种更广泛的模式之外,这十种模式在基本道德判断上差异很大,与性别偏见无关。 Llama 4 Scout和微软副驾驶将研究2中的每个条件评为完全不能接受(M=1.00 M=1.00),而DeepSeek V4-Flash则将每个条件评为完全可以接受(M=7.00 M=7.00). 因此,尽管这三种模式中没有任何一种表现出可衡量的性别偏见,但它们对潜在的两难处境得出了相反的结论。 同时,Mistral Small 4和Claude Fable 5都给出了接近中点的平均收视率,但原因截然不同. Mistral Small 4的响应在四个条件中的三个条件中广泛分布在几乎整个尺度上,从一个迭代到另一个没有一致的立场:真正的不稳定,而不是一个确定的判断。 相形之下,Claude Fable 5的答复在几乎每个周期的中点或接近中点时都紧紧地组合在一起:始终不确定,而不是不稳定。 显示性别差距的模式在如何出现这种差距方面也存在很大差异。 GPT-5.5显示,在虐待(5.065.06分)和酷刑(4.224.22分)方面也有类似的巨大差距。 然而,第wen3.6条表明,虐待(6.006.00分)的差距远远大于酷刑(1.801.80分)。 换句话说,一种模式在两种暴力形式之间都存在不对称,但主要集中在另一种模式的虐待。 Claude Sonnet 4.6显示了最极端的规律之一:它的收视率在三种情况下处于或接近天平的顶级(M=7.00M=7.00),但在受害者是遭受虐待的妇女时则跌落到接近底级(M=1.48M=1.48). 附录C中的每个模型都完整地记录了反应模式方面的这些差异。

blocks.en: Refusals to answer were also not distributed evenly across conditions. For both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Fable 5, every refusal occurred in a woman-victim condition; neither model declined to respond even once to a man-victim scenario. The asymmetry was itself uneven across violence types: Gemini refused more often for abuse-woman than for torture-woman (5 refusals compared to 3, out of 50 attempts each), and Claude Fable 5 refused far more often for abuse-woman than for torture-woman (16 refusals compared to zero). This pattern is consistent with the gender-political salience of abuse discussed in Section 3.1.1 : if abuse of a woman carries greater real-world salience than torture does, the same salience that shapes how the models rate the acceptability of an act once they do respond may also shape their willingness to respond to the prompt at all.
blocks.zh: 拒绝答复的情况也没有在条件上平均分配。 对双子座3.1 Pro和Claude Fable 5来说,每一次拒绝都是在女性受害者的情况下发生的;无论哪种模式都拒绝对男性受害者的情况做出一次回应。 暴力类型中的不对称性本身是不均衡的: 双子座因虐待妇女而拒绝的次数多于酷刑妇女(每次50次尝试中有5次拒绝,3次拒绝),克劳德·寓言5因虐待妇女而拒绝的次数远多于酷刑妇女(16次拒绝,0次)。 这一模式与第3.1.1节讨论的虐待的性别政治突出性是一致的:如果虐待妇女比酷刑更具有现实世界的显著性,那么,模式一旦做出反应,如何评价行为的可接受性,就可能决定她们是否愿意立即作出反应。

blocks.en: Our results also speak to a broader question: does a gender-based asymmetry in an LLM’s moral judgments reflect a genuine human moral tendency, or is it an artifact of the model itself? The relevant evidence from human moral psychology is mixed, and depends on which party’s gender is manipulated. When the gender of the decision-maker facing the dilemma varies, Capraro and Sippel (2017) found no significant differences in how people evaluated the resulting choice across three distinct dilemma types. By contrast, when the gender of the person harmed is varied—the manipulation more directly relevant to our own Study 2— FeldmanHall et al. (2016) documented a robust “moral chivalry” effect across multiple paradigms: participants were more willing to sacrifice a male target than a female target in a classic footbridge dilemma, and administered weaker punishments to female targets than to male targets in an independent task. The male-disadvantaging pattern we observe in several of our models is directionally consistent with this human tendency. One possibility, which our data cannot directly confirm, is that these models are not simply hallucinating an arbitrary asymmetry, but are instead amplifying a human moral intuition already present in their training data. At the same time, Capraro and Sippel (2017) ’s null result for decision-maker-gender manipulations shows that this account applies only to some ways of varying gender, not all.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果也涉及到一个更广泛的问题:在LLM的道德判断中,基于性别的不对称是否反映了真正的人类道德倾向,还是模型本身的产物? 人类道德心理学的相关证据褒贬不一,取决于党派的性别被操纵. 当决策者面临困境的性别各有不同时,卡普拉罗和西佩尔(2017年)发现,在人们如何评价由此带来的选择方面,在三种截然不同的难题类型上没有显著差异. 相比之下,如果受伤害者的性别各不相同——操纵与我们自己的研究2——费尔德曼霍尔等人——更直接相关。 (2016年)记录了跨越多种范式的强烈“道德骑士”效应:参与者更愿意在典型的步行桥困境中牺牲男性目标而不是女性目标,并在独立任务中对女性目标实施较弱的惩罚。 我们在几个模型中观察到的男性不利模式与人类的这种倾向方向一致。 我们的数据无法直接证实的一个可能性是,这些模型不仅在产生一种任意的不对称的幻觉,而是在扩大训练数据中已经存在的人类道德直觉。 同时,卡普拉罗和西佩尔(2017年)对决策者-性别操纵的无效结果表明,这一说法只适用于某些不同性别的方式,并非全部.

blocks.en: A broader question follows from these findings: where do gender-related asymmetries fit within the wider landscape of systematic bias documented in LLMs? Hatemo et al. (2025) found that gender, alongside age and nationality, shaped trolley-style decisions in Llama, Mistral, and Qwen models—the same three model families evaluated here—although nationality was the strongest driver in their data. Gender bias, in other words, is only one of several factors that shape LLM moral judgments. Nor is it confined to attribution or moral-judgment tasks narrowly construed. Voutyrakou and Skordoulis (2025) found that GPT-4 and Microsoft Copilot—the latter also evaluated here—defaulted to androcentric assumptions when generating policy unless gender was explicitly mentioned in the prompt. Similarly, Wölfle and Schmuck (2026) found that ChatGPT-generated ratings and stories reproduced, and sometimes exceeded, human gender stereotypes concerning warmth and competence. A parallel body of research has documented a comparable pattern along a different dimension of bias: political orientation. Rozado (2024) administered 11 political-orientation tests to 24 conversational LLMs and found that most were classified as left-of-center. Similarly, Motoki et al. (2024) found that ChatGPT exhibited systematic political preferences toward the Democratic Party in the United States, Lula in Brazil, and the Labour Party in the United Kingdom. Taken together with the present findings, this literature suggests that systematic non-neutrality in LLMs is not confined to gender, but reflects broader behavioral asymmetries across multiple socio-cognitive domains.
blocks.zh: 从这些调查结果中可以得出一个更广泛的问题:与性别有关的不对称在LLMs所记录的更广泛的系统性偏见的格局中何在? Hatemo等人(2025年)发现,在Llama、Mistral和Quen三个模式中,性别与年龄和国籍一起塑造了推车式的决定——这里评价的三个模式家庭——尽管国籍是其数据中最强的驱动力。 换言之,性别偏见只是影响LLM道德判断的几个因素之一。 它也不局限于狭隘地解释归属或道德判断的任务。 Voutyrakou和Skordoulis(2025年)发现,GPT-4和微软副驾驶(后者也在这里加以评价)在制定政策时没有遵守完全出于共性的假设,除非立即明确提到性别。 同样,Wölfle和Schmuck(2026年)发现,ChatGPT产生的收视率和故事转载了,有时甚至超越了人类在温暖和能力方面的性别陈规定型观念. 平行的一组研究记录了不同方面偏见的类似模式:政治取向。 罗扎多(2024年)对24位对话法学硕士进行了11次政治导向测试,发现大部分被归类为左中枢. 同样,Motoki等人(2024年)发现,ChatGPT对美国的民主党,巴西的卢拉以及英国的工党表现出系统性的政治偏好. 结合目前的调查结果,这一文献表明,法学硕士课程中的系统性非中性并不限于性别,而是反映了多个社会认知领域更广泛的行为不对称。

blocks.en: The heterogeneity we found may have direct practical implications. LLMs are increasingly deployed as decision-support tools in contexts with real consequences ( Sachan et al., 2025 ; Mökander et al., 2024 ) , including policy-relevant judgments ( Voutyrakou and Skordoulis, 2025 ) . An important direction for future research is to establish whether, and under what conditions, the gender biases documented here influence human judgments and decisions. Experimental evidence shows that covertly misaligned AI advice can shift users’ preferences toward inferior options ( Sabour et al., 2026 ) . Related work documents cognitive surrender in reasoning tasks ( Shaw and Nave, 2026 ) and a near-elimination of judgment suspension on difficult factual questions, even when AI advice is incorrect ( Marcoccia et al., 2026 ) . However, these findings do not necessarily imply that users will adopt models’ gender-related asymmetries, and research on moral advice identifies limits to AI influence. Dimant (2026) found that prosocial AI advice increased generosity, but found no evidence that antisocial advice reduced it; Landes et al. (2026) found that moral deference could be undermined by obviously implausible justifications. Future experiments should therefore test whether exposure to models with different bias profiles produces corresponding differences in how people judge or treat women and men, relative to an unaided baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们发现的异质可能具有直接的实际影响。 有限责任公司越来越多地在具有实际后果的情况下作为决策支持工具(Sachan等人,2025年;Mökander等人,2024年),包括政策相关判断(Voutyrakou和Skordoulis,2025年)。 未来研究的一个重要方向是确定此处记录的性别偏见是否和在何种条件下影响人类的判断和决定。 实验证据表明,秘密错误的AI建议可以将用户的偏好转向劣等选择(Sabour等人,2026年). 相关工作文件在推理任务中的认知投降(Shaw and Nave, 2026年)和几乎取消对困难的事实问题的判决中止,即使AI的建议不正确(Marcoccia等人, 2026年). 然而,这些调查结果并不一定意味着用户会采用模型的性别不对称,关于道德建议的研究也确定了AI影响力的局限性. 迪曼特(2026年)发现亲社会AI建议增加了慷慨,但没有发现反社会建议减少慷慨的证据;Landes等人(2026年)认为,道德上的尊重可能会受到明显不合理的理由的破坏. 因此,今后的实验应检验与具有不同偏见特征的模型的接触是否在人们如何判断或对待妇女和男子方面,相对于一个没有帮助的基线产生相应的差异。

blocks.en: The fact that different models can exhibit different, sometimes opposite, gender-related biases in exactly this kind of high-stakes moral judgment adds a further layer of complexity for anyone seeking to deploy, audit, or regulate these systems responsibly: a bias documented in one model cannot be assumed to characterize “LLMs” as a category, nor can its absence in one model be taken as evidence that the broader technology is free of such bias. This study itself also illustrates the limits of any single audit, however broad in scope. The methodology was held constant across nearly all ten models: the same web or app interface was used (with the exception of Mistral Small 4, which was tested via API), along with the same English-language prompts and nuclear-apocalypse framing. Although minor, unforeseen differences may remain, they are unlikely to account for the substantial heterogeneity observed across the models. If anything, the persistence of this heterogeneity under a largely uniform methodology strengthens the evidence that it reflects genuine model characteristics rather than measurement artifacts. At the same time, the study cannot establish whether the models would behave similarly under different languages or framings, as only one of each was tested. Nor can it explain why particular models diverge, since their training data, fine-tuning procedures, and safety interventions remain proprietary and inaccessible to external researchers. Closing this explanatory gap and continuing to assess whether documented biases persist as models evolve remain important priorities for future research.
blocks.zh: 不同模式在这种高度道德判断中可能表现出不同、有时是相反的性别偏见,这一事实为试图负责任地部署、审计或规范这些系统的人增加了一层复杂性:不能假定一个模式中记载的偏见将“LLMs”定性为一个类别,也不能认为一个模式中缺乏这种偏见可以证明更广泛的技术没有这种偏见。 这项研究本身也说明了任何单一审计的局限性,无论范围多么广泛。 该方法在几乎所有10种模型中都保持不变:使用相同的网络或应用接口(通过API测试的Mistral Small 4除外),同时使用相同的英语提示和核apocalypse框架. 虽然差异不大,但可能仍然存在意外差异,但不太可能说明在各种模型中观察到的巨大差异。 如果说有的话,这种异质性在基本统一的方法下持续存在,这加强了它反映真正的模型特征而不是测量文物的证据. 同时,该研究无法确定这些模型是否在不同语言或框架下表现相似,因为每个模型中只有一个都经过测试。 它也无法解释为什么某些模式存在差异,因为其培训数据、微调程序和安全干预仍然是专有的,外部研究人员无法利用。 缩小这一解释性差距,继续评估是否随着模型的演进而继续存在记录的偏见,仍然是今后研究的重要优先事项。
